what_changed: P1 baseline timing only: process p1 is driven with the same mix (endurance-load drive, unchanged) for warmup.load_s right after it is ready, then left idle.

The 3 baseline samples (forced GC, median, as before) start no earlier than warmup.baseline_after_ready_s after p1 was ready and no earlier than warmup.min_idle_s after the warm-up driver exited (every warm-up flow finished, past the 10 s observation window).
Between warm-up and baseline the run records 'settle' samples (forced GC, every 15 s); they are not pass-condition inputs.

why.D1: With no load, Culvert drops from 29 to 25 goroutines about 85 s after start: two net/http client keep-alive connections close when idle. The PRO-540 baseline (60-70 s after start) was taken before that.
why.D2: With logTraffic off the heap returns to +0.87 MB, of which 0.58 MB is the child-app classifier built lazily (sync.Once) on the first inspected request, after the old baseline.
why.D3: With logTraffic on (as in production and in this run) 2 minutes of load leave +3.80 MB, the same as 30 minutes: the bounded reqlog ring (MaxRing 5,000, full after about 40 s at this rate). The warm-up fills it before the baseline.

revision.unchanged: Thresholds (recovery_pct 10, recovery_within_s 60, steady_skip_s 120, steady_slope_pct_per_min 1.0), mix and rates, load_s 1800, actions at 600 s and 1200 s, sampling, binaries' sources, verdict code. Traffic logging stays on.
